tasks.CountPeopleAtLeastOneBanana: Calculate the number of people who ate at least one banana last week based on the given frequency data.
tasks.PeopleWhoAteAtLeastOneBanana: Subtract the number of people who ate zero bananas from the total number of people surveyed.
tasks.TotalPeopleSurveyed: Sum up all frequencies to get the total number of people surveyed.
